delivery: file URL, installed Google Chrome driven by Playwright, no server

results.name: home keyboard entry, exact two primary actions and clear input label
empty and long errors retain text, announce and focus input; Back retains draft
keyboard toggle, visible count and undo restore previous value/focus
user text renders safely, without injected elements or network
reload resumes saved items and persisted last-toggle undo
compact preference works by keyboard and survives reload
320px reflow, compact targets and enlarged text remain usable
corrupt JSON is untouched while new session-only changes remain usable
invalid stored schema is untouched rather than reset
write failure is truthful and recoverable with successful retry/reload
read denial preserves prior storage and never pretends a save succeeded
detected concurrent change is never overwritten

limitations: Chromium only; physical devices, Safari, Firefox and real screen readers untested.
Keyboard plus DOM accessibility inspection is not a screen-reader session or usability study.
localStorage file URL behaviour varies by browser and location; saves are not a backup.
Conflict detection is best effort; no atomic multi-tab transaction is promised.
